title: Martinouxx Fan Mod
description: The Martinouxx Fan Mod is a funny fan mod for Martinouxx. It adds two features: the Subscribe Button, which you can eat to summon a baby Martinouxx, and the Ninario Painting, showing Martinouxx’s official server.
body:
The **Martinouxx Fan Mod** is a fan mod dedicated to the legendary [Martinouxx](https://youtube.com/@martinouxx)!  
It adds two brand new, ridiculous features to Minecraft:  

### The *Subscribe Button*  
> Craft: 8 Redstone + 1 White Dye in the center  

This button isn’t just for decoration...  
> **When you eat it**, a **baby Martinouxx** spawns nearby!  
He’s *adorable*, *annoying*, and *impossible to ignore*. Get ready for chaos :)  

### The *Ninario Painting*  
A custom painting that proudly displays **Ninario**, the official **Martinouxx server** 🖥️  
Perfect for decorating your base and showing your fan spirit!  

---

## Features  
✅ The *Subscribe Button* (edible item)  
✅ Spawns a baby Martinouxx  
✅ Adds the *Ninario Painting*  

---

> “Eat the button. Summon the legend.” – *Me*
